The statements inside that branch were not re-read. Entities of each type are sorted in device-address then numeric entity-address order. When the HeatingZone and HVACRoom counts are equal, the n-th room and the n-th heating zone fill zone n only if all presented entity addresses of both types are valid. A malformed room or zone address aborts the pairing even where the remaining valid counts are equal, so two valid room addresses and two valid zone addresses plus one malformed room or zone address leave every zone unresolved. When the counts are unequal, for example three HeatingZone and two HVACRoom entities, the pairing is ambiguous, every zone slot stays unresolved, and no zone data is published. No pairing is inferred and there is no unconditional zone fill. SemReg identifies rooms and zones by the remote identification, rooms as their own kind, separately from this native pairing.

uncertainty: The captured on-installation comparison is the leaf's recorded verification level. A mismatch on a run is a runtime conflict shown on the leaf, never a reason to drop the mapping or its publication. Entities of each type are sorted in device-address then numeric entity-address order. When the HeatingZone and HVACRoom counts are equal, the n-th room and the n-th heating zone fill zone n only if all presented entity addresses of both types are valid. A malformed room or zone address aborts the pairing even where the remaining valid counts are equal, so two valid room addresses and two valid zone addresses plus one malformed room or zone address leave every zone unresolved. When the counts are unequal, for example three HeatingZone and two HVACRoom entities, the pairing is ambiguous, every zone slot stays unresolved, and no zone data is published. No pairing is inferred and there is no unconditional zone fill. SemReg identifies rooms and zones by the remote identification, rooms as their own kind, separately from this native pairing.
